sourceNote: High Class pack, 10 packs x 10 cards. Site sample: 1,800 BOX. Per box: 1 Pokemon SAR GUARANTEED + ~20% support SAR; 3 AR GUARANTEED; SR ~20%; UR ~10% — 4.5 hits/box total. OUR CATALOG CAVEAT: this set's Scrydex rarity coding merges AR/SAR/UR into one 64-card ultra_rare tier, so the four measured bands are modelled as one merged slot at their sum (4.5/box = 0.45/pack) with a 4-card floor for the guaranteed SAR+3AR. The tier average therefore blends $3 ARs with $200+ SARs — the EV total is right, per-card odds within the tier are approximate. double_rare 0.15/pack is an unsourced holdover. Rates come from ポケゲトちゃんねる (pokemon-infomation.com), which aggregates real box-opening tallies from card shops and individuals — the closest thing Japanese sets have to a primary study, since neither The Pokemon Company nor any English source publishes Japanese odds. Confidence is MEDIUM: the samples are large (hundreds to thousands of boxes) and the methodology is consistent across sets, but the underlying tallies are not independently auditable. Per-pack probabilities are the site's per-BOX figures divided by the box's pack count, which is separately sourced. NOTE ON GUARANTEES: the per-box guarantees (1 SAR/box on High Class, 3 AR/box, 1 ACE/box etc.) are folded into the slot rates above rather than modelled as engine floors — a floor attaches to a PRODUCT, so a single-pack product would inherit the whole box's guarantee and read absurdly positive. The rates are per-box tallies divided by pack count, so a box's EV already reflects every guarantee.
